Definition: a vestibule (as a limit); also a dish (for holding blood or wine)
BiblicalUsage: çaph is the word for a vestibule, a threshold, also a dish. It turns up 28 times in the Old Testament, and wherever it lands it keeps that same plain sense. In 1 Chronicles and 1 Kings you can see it doing exactly what the word says.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çaph matters because God gave us the word for a vestibule, a threshold, also a dish. God did not put this word in Scripture 28 times for us to skip over it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
